name: Gymnast
l1: Passive: Vault may move through 1 allied character during movement, but must end on an empty tile.
l2: +1 MOVE. Vault may pass through an enemy instead. After Vaulting, this character may move 1 additional tile.
l3: Aurora Acrobat: +1 ATK and +1 MOVE. Once per turn after Vaulting, this character may deal 1 damage to an adjacent enemy without spending AP.
role: Agile runner who crosses crowded lines and exploits openings created by the troupe.
review_notes: Kept as reviewed. Separate draft ID preserves the original prototype card until the Far North team is implemented.

name: Buran, White Siberian Tiger
l1: AP Ability: Pounce moves Buran up to 2 tiles. His next attack gains +2 ATK. Only usable while not carrying a rider. Attacking remains a separate action.
l3: Aurora Predator: +1 ATK. Once per turn, when Pounce's empowered attack defeats an enemy, Buran may move up to 2 tiles and regain 1 character AP.
role: A fighter-first Mount whose burst attack competes with his transport role.
review_notes: Base ATK reduced to 1. Pounce itself is an AP movement ability, not a free preparation action. Level 2 push removed by the designer.

name: Oleg Baranov, Iron Strongman
l1: Passive: After attacking, Oleg may push an adjacent enemy up to 2 tiles directly away from him.
l3: Unbroken Strongman: While Oleg is at full HP, he gains +2 ATK and +1 MOVE.
role: Creates openings with post-attack pushes; becomes a fast heavy hitter while fully healed.
review_notes: Designer replaced the earlier AP push and AP-refresh proposal. Level 3 bonuses are conditional, not permanent: level-3 full-health stats are 5/4/4/1, otherwise 5/2/3/1.

name: Pavel Sokolov
l1: Follow the Impossible: Once per turn, after an adjacent ally moves, Pavel may move 1 tile without spending AP.
l2: No Longer Lost: +1 MOVE and +1 HP.
l3: His Own Way Through: Once per match, after Pavel moves, choose up to 2 allies. Each may move up to 2 tiles without spending AP.
role: A displaced survivor who first follows others, then creates a dramatic opening for the troupe.

name: Vera Kargina, Meteor Spear
l1: AP Ability: Take Your Opening chooses an ally within 3 tiles. That ally may immediately make a basic attack without spending AP.
l2: Lead the Charge: +1 HP. The chosen ally may move 1 tile before making that attack.
l3: Weathered by the North: All damage dealt to Vera is reduced by 1.
role: A durable village leader who turns her allies' positioning into sudden attacks.
review_notes: Base HP 5 and ATK 1 per designer. Level 3 damage reduction replaces the earlier once-per-match two-ally activation. Granted attacks use normal attack range and line of sight.

name: Dmitri Voronov, Knife Thrower
l1: AP Ability: Throw and Slip makes a basic attack, then moves Dmitri up to 1 tile without spending additional AP.
l2: Between the Performers: +1 MOVE. Dmitri's attacks may ignore allied characters when checking line of sight.
l3: One Last Knife: +1 ATK. Once per turn, after using Throw and Slip, Dmitri may immediately make another basic attack without spending AP.
role: A fragile mobile attacker: attack, reposition, then attack again at Level 3.
review_notes: Replaces the earlier Twin Blades multi-target proposal. No Level 2 RANGE increase; the approved Level 2 gives MOVE and allied line-of-sight bypass.

name: Nadia Belaya
l1: AP Ability: A Breath of Warmth heals an ally within 3 tiles by 1 HP. Nadia may then move 1 tile without spending additional AP.
l2: Back on Your Feet: +1 HP. The healed ally may also move 1 tile without spending AP.
l3: No One Lost to the Snow: Once per match, instead of healing 1 HP, A Breath of Warmth restores the chosen ally to full HP and lets it regain 1 character AP.
role: Healer who keeps the troupe moving and restores Oleg's full-health bonuses.
review_notes: Chosen as the base team's Mystic instead of Aksinya Morozova. The Level 3 character AP refresh does not restore shared pool AP.
